source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Fuel, p.6M-1

procedures.title: Carburetors: general
steps: Identify a carburetor by its part number and/or specifications; similar-looking units are often not interchangeable.
For overhaul and bench adjustments, use Section 6M of the Overhaul Manual for that carburetor; carburetor specifications are at the back of this manual.

procedures.title: Carburetor: preliminary checks
steps: Warm the engine fully; from cold, run it at least 15 minutes.
Check torque on the carburetor-to-manifold and manifold-to-head bolts to rule out air leaks.
Check the manifold heat control valve (if used) for free movement and proper spring tension.

procedures.title: Idle speed and mixture: adjust
steps: Preliminary setting: turn each mixture screw lightly to its seat, then back out 3 turns (never tighten against the seat).

Engine at operating temperature, air cleaner on, pre-heater and choke valves wide open: set the idle speed screw to the specified rpm (automatic in Drive, manual in Neutral) (see figure 1C in the manual).
Turn the mixture screw for the highest steady idle, then reset the speed screw to the decal rpm.
Turn the mixture screw in for a 20 rpm drop (lean roll).
Back the mixture screw out 1/4 turn.
notes: With air conditioning, set idle with A/C OFF, except 325 hp and 350 hp 327 engines with manual transmission (and L-4/L-6 automatics), which are set with A/C ON.
